name: Clipboard
author: VanillaGreen
description: Find and paste anything you copied earlier. Your history is saved on disk, and Shift+Delete in the Clipboard list clears it.

requirements.purpose: Reads each copy for the history
Puts an entry of the history back on the clipboard

binds.info: Opens your clipboard history, where you pick an earlier copy to paste, or closes it.
Copies the selection in the terminal, application or VGS field you work in.
Pastes the clipboard into the terminal, application or VGS field you work in.
Cuts the selection in the application or VGS field you work in. A terminal has no cut.
